descriptor.name: GGPEN/AGT Cuanza Sul official property-registration parcels — Sumbe
descriptor.scope: Cuanza Sul provincial property-registration polygons. Reviewed discovery supports substantial partial Sumbe coverage, not completeness. No municipal or temporal filter is inferred.

evidence: Official MinFin/AGT Inscreva Já property-registration application routes its map broker to GGPEN (evidence/official-portal-excerpts.json); current GGPEN province 08 configuration selects the exact reviewed Cuanza Sul layer (evidence/official-layers.json).

Public first-party ArcGIS item owner ANGOLA_GGPEN and exact layer metadata establish the official urban-property polygon registry workflow, with provider GlobalID_2 identity and real unchanged polygons (evidence/source-item.json, evidence/source-layer.json, evidence/sample-output.geojson).
Property-registration parcel records, not sale listings, development proposals or zoning overlays. Legal-title equivalence and currentness are not established; see evidence/source-review.json.

coverage.basis: Accepted discovery has four distributed positive urban windows; initial qualification rereads three known IDs. Neither this initial pass nor 13 bounded cells establishes citywide completeness.
